title: Cold Logistics
logline: An independent logistics hauler refuses to pay protection money and gets their convoy stranded in an ion storm, requiring desperate rescue operations from rival pilots before the crew freezes.

roles.description: A fiercely independent trucker who refuses to bow to the syndicate.
Cold and calculating, ensures the protection racket holds.
Three heavy freighters caught in a dead drift.
A fortified asteroid serving as a toll booth.
A heavy interdictor designed to drag ships out of warp.
A loose coalition of independent pilots too terrified to help.
The physical debris field of the damaged ships.

public_situation: The {role:independent_union} is terrified after the {role:stubborn_hauler}'s convoy vanished during a routine run through a heavy ion storm.
private_truth: The syndicate deliberately lured the convoy into the storm's heart and disabled their drives to set an example.

beats.public_change: A faint distress beacon punches through the storm interference.

missions.reason: The hauler begs the pilot to brave the storm and scan the convoy to assess the critical damage.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the damage was caused by precision EMP weapons, not the storm.

missions.reason: The pilot must dock and physically retrieve the convoy's encrypted flight recorder before the cold destroys it.
missions.private_fact: The crew is suffering from severe hypothermia.

beats.public_change: The syndicate claims salvage rights over the convoy, warning anyone against helping.

missions.reason: The hauler desperately asks the pilot to deliver a formal challenge to the syndicate base, proving they survived the EMP.
missions.private_fact: This is a distraction to keep the syndicate's attention off the rescue.

missions.reason: The pilot must quietly purchase heavy thermal regulators from the black market at the base.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate marks up the price massively.

beats.public_change: The syndicate realizes a rescue is underway and sends a hunter.

missions.reason: The pilot must intercept and destroy the enforcer ship before it reaches the frozen convoy.
missions.private_fact: The enforcer ship is carrying the only warp-capable tug cable in the sector.

missions.reason: The pilot must shoot the tug cable module off the enforcer's wreckage.
missions.private_fact: Without the cable, the convoy can never be moved.

beats.public_change: The pilot returns to the storm to drag the convoy to safety.

missions.reason: The syndicate enforcer contacts the pilot, offering a massive bounty if they simply destroy the frozen convoy instead of towing it.
missions.private_fact: The hauler hails the pilot, offering to make them a lifetime partner in the union if they tow them home.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the hauler's offer and tows the convoy.
resolutions.summary: The convoy is saved. The independent union rallies behind the hauler, breaking the syndicate's hold on the sector's trade routes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot dragged a freezing convoy out of an ion storm, breaking a syndicate protection racket.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the convoy for the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The convoy is shattered. The syndicate cements its brutal rule over the independent pilots, and the pilot gets rich in blood money.
The storm finally breaks the convoy's life support. The crew freezes to death, and the syndicate quietly salvages the ships.

loose_threads.detail: The EMP charges used on the convoy were bought with a union welfare-fund account that was closed the year before.
The hauler mentions their flight path was a closely guarded secret known only to the union leadership.

radio_hooks: {role:independent_union} issues travel advisory for severe ion storms.
Rumors of 'ghost ships' drifting in the outer sectors.

voice_direction.stubborn_hauler: Gruff, short sentences. Refuses to admit anything is wrong, even when it plainly is.
